label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Show Them What Others Love
body: A short testimonial or glowing review can build trust and show new readers the value you offer.
caption:
People trust recommendations from others. Sharing a positive quote from a happy customer or client can be a powerful way to show new subscribers that your work resonates. It's a simple, honest way to build confidence without hype. Think about adding a short, authentic testimonial in your next email. Who could you feature? 🤔
